title: simira alba
intro: Simira alba, commonly known as white simira, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can aid in the treatment of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Simira alba include its ability to lower fever, reduce pain, and treat various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Simira alba include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
